note: Hand-picked by eye from zoomed 1920x1080 frames of source.mp4 at time t. Court origin = corner at the left baseline / far sideline; x runs along the length toward the right basket, y runs across toward the camera side. Standard high-school court 84 x 50 ft (25.6 x 15.24 m); lane 12 ft wide (lane lines at y = 5.79 and 9.45 m); free-throw line 19 ft (5.79 m) from the baseline. The landmarks are the four corners of the painted lane at each end. Accuracy is roughly +-5 px. All four points in a keyframe sit around one lane, so positions far from it (the other half, the sidelines) extrapolate and are less accurate.
